require(root != out and root not in out.parents, "output must be outside input tree")
    # Canonical strings can still differ for case aliases and APFS firmlinks.
    # Compare directory identities before authentication/replay or any writes.
    root_info = root.stat()
    root_identity = (root_info.st_dev, root_info.st_ino)
    for ancestor in (parent, *parent.parents):
        ancestor_info = ancestor.stat()
        require((ancestor_info.st_dev, ancestor_info.st_ino) != root_identity,
                "output must be outside input tree (physical directory alias)")
    # A firmlink can hide a physical ancestor from the output spelling.
    # The already authenticated closed tree enumerates every input directory.
    parent_info = parent.stat()
    parent_identity = (parent_info.st_dev, parent_info.st_ino)
    input_directories = {""}
    for name in blobs:
        safe_name(name)
        input_directories.update(str(p) for p in PurePosixPath(name).parents if str(p) != ".")
    for name in sorted(input_directories):
        directory_info = (root / name).lstat()
        require(stat.S_ISDIR(directory_info.st_mode), "input directory changed before build")
        require((directory_info.st_dev, directory_info.st_ino) != parent_identity,
                "output must be outside input tree (indexed directory alias)")
